add.title: Adding books
add.p1: Tap the + in the header to add a book. Title, author and status are required, everything else is optional.
add.p2: Enter an ISBN and tap “Look up” to fill in title, author and cover automatically. This uses Open Library and Google Books and needs an internet connection.
add.p3: You can add your own cover photo or replace the one that was found. Tap a book in the list to see or edit its details.

scan.title: Scanning an ISBN
scan.p1: Next to the ISBN field, the camera button opens the scanner. Hold the barcode on the back of the book inside the frame. It is recognised automatically and the book is looked up right away.
scan.p2: The live camera needs your permission and only works on secure connections (HTTPS).
scan.p3: If it does not work, tap “Take photo” and photograph the barcode. Move close, avoid reflections and make sure the bars are sharp.
scan.p4: Still no luck? Type the ISBN by hand. Only ISBN-13 barcodes (starting with 978 or 979) can be scanned.

wish.title: Wishlist
wish.p1: Books with the status “Wish” can have a price and a release date.
wish.p2: A wish counts as “Available” once its release date has been reached, or if it has no release date. Use the Available filter or the tile on the start page to see what you can buy now.

find.title: Finding books
find.p1: Use the search field to find books by title, author or ISBN. The filter narrows the list down by status, favourites, available wishes and category.
find.p2: Tap the star on a book to mark it as a favourite. The start page shows how many books you have in each group.

offline.title: Using SimpLib offline
offline.p1: Once loaded, SimpLib works without internet. You can browse, add and edit books offline.
offline.p2: Only the ISBN lookup needs a connection. When a cover is found, it is saved on your device so it also shows offline.
offline.p3: You can install SimpLib like an app with the “Install” or “Add to home screen” option of your browser.

backup.title: Backup and moving devices
backup.p1: Your books are stored only in this browser on this device. There is no account and no automatic sync between devices.
backup.p2: Clearing the browser or site data deletes your library. Export it regularly in the settings to keep a backup.
backup.p3: Use “Import library” to restore a backup or to move your books to another device. “Add to library” keeps your current books and adds the new ones, “Replace library” deletes the current ones first.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: SimpLib has no account and no server of its own. Your library stays on your device.
privacy.p2: Only the ISBN you look up is sent to Open Library and Google Books to find the book. Camera images are analysed on your device and never uploaded.
